modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Perform diagnosis of vehicle mechanical system/aggregates

pcs.pc_description: perform root cause analysis to identify the cause of faults in the vehicle
carry out diagnosis of noise in engine
use compression tester and cylinder leakage tester to detect any leakage in cylinder
use engine fault diagnosis table of symptom to identify possible causes and remedies for the identified faults/failures in engine
conduct cooling system leakage test, antifreeze content test and operating temperature test by using cooling fault diagnosis tables
conduct lubrication system diagnosis with oil pressure testing kit and by using lubrication fault diagnosis tables
conduct brake fluid diagnosis with brake fluid tester, brake roller test, disc runout test by using brake fluid diagnosis table
conduct steering and wheels diagnosis with tire pressure, tread depth, wheel balancer, four- wheel alignment machine by using steering fault diagnosis table and tire fault diagnostic table
conduct suspension diagnosis with damper operation test, trim height test by using suspension fault diagnosis table
conduct clutch diagnosis with clutch tests by using clutch fault diagnosis table
conduct automatic gearbox diagnosis with stall test and kickdown test using automatic gear box fault diagnosis table
record and collate all the results in the required formats
analyse and compare the results with the standard values, regulatory norms and benchmarked values to identify causes of faults and suggest remedies and preventing actions to repair or avoid them
submit the report to concerned department for rectification of faults in vehicle

modules.module_title: Perform diagnosis of vehicle OBD system

pcs.pc_description: conduct diagnosis process on various sensors i.e., crank and cam sensor, wheel speed sensor, Throttle position sensor, Accelerator pedal position sensor, hot film air mass sensor, temperature sensor, knock sensor, oxygen/ lambda sensor, strain gauge, common rail fuel pressure sensor, MAP sensor, rain sensor, yaw rate and acceleration sensor etc. available in the vehicle
analyse and compare the signal of faulty sensor with the recommended input signal of correct sensor to identify the deviations in signal, cause and preventive measures of the fault in the sensor

conduct diagnosis process on communication network systems i.e. CAN, LIN and FLEXRAY available in the vehicle

analyse and compare the signal of faulty network system with the recommended signal of correct network signal to identify the deviations in signal, cause and preventive measures of the fault in the network system
record and collate all the results in the required formats
analyse and compare the results with the standard values, regulatory norms and benchmarked values to identify causes of faults and suggest remedies and preventing actions to repair or avoid them
submit the report to concerned department for rectification of faults in vehicle
